# `armadad`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

armadad runs on every machine of an Armada cluster: the control plane
(`armadad server`), the node agent (`armadad agent`), and the embedded
container runtime (`armadad runtime`), each under systemd. It also sets a
machine up (init, join) and inspects it (doctor). It runs as root.
Manage apps with `armada`.

## Global flags

Every command takes these.

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--config string` | client config file (default `$ARMADA_CONFIG, else ~/.armada/config if it exists, else /etc/armada/admin.config`) |

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`armadad agent`](armadad-agent.md) | Run the node agent |
| [`armadad backup`](armadad-backup.md) | Back up the control plane (state, keys, certificates) |
| [`armadad doctor`](armadad-doctor.md) | Check that this host is ready to run Armada safely |
| [`armadad init`](armadad-init.md) | Initialize a new cluster on this machine |
| [`armadad join`](armadad-join.md) | Join this machine to a cluster as a node |
| [`armadad restore`](armadad-restore.md) | Restore the control plane from a backup |
| [`armadad runtime`](armadad-runtime.md) | Run the embedded container runtime (started by systemd) |
| [`armadad server`](armadad-server.md) | Run the control plane (and, by default, this node's agent) |
| [`armadad upgrade`](armadad-upgrade.md) | Upgrade this machine to the latest (or a given) release and restart its service |
| [`armadad user`](armadad-user.md) | Recover a user's credentials on a server |
| [`armadad version`](armadad-version.md) | Print build information and the latest release |
